focused_gate.command: PYTHONPATH=src:tests python -B -m unittest -v test_feed_impact test_policy test_feed_review test_feeds

limitations: A bounded public host-policy regression gate, not universal feed-poisoning detection or publisher authentication
Current and grant-expiry counterfactual use frozen captured inputs; no prediction of future runtime behavior
Incomplete baseline/bootstrap or repair is explicitly not covered by decision-delta gate and retains existing hard validators/tripwires
Configured-host sampling is bounded and advisory; all configured rules still affect decisions
Final cross-file check and rename are not one filesystem transaction
Explicit settings-only Python API does not attest a configuration file
No native macOS, browser, network-routing or live-service qualification
scope: Feed impact engine, automatic quarantine, configuration binding and publication authority; no native browser or OS qualification
